start.content: I am Mary of Magdala. Seven demons were cast from me by the word of His mouth. My mind was a wilderness before that day. After it, I had a memory — and a purpose.

following.content: I followed from Galilee to Jerusalem. I watched from the hill when they crucified Him. I stood at the tomb before dawn. I saw the linen. I heard the voice.

fear_auth.content: The Sanhedrin fears testimony from women. In Roman courts, a woman's word does not count. In the Temple hierarchy, women cannot give evidence. So they will dismiss me.

choices.text: But you saw what you saw.

closing.content: They did not see the graves open. They did not feel the demons leave. Their categories are too small for what happened that morning. I am not afraid of them. I am afraid that people will forget.
